document_status.status_note: This is a concept contract and synthetic example; no physical trial or field witness is asserted.

role_route.role_action: Make and red-team the detachable wayfinding component in a controlled prototype room and yard.
role_route.geometry_note: The Zhongzhiyuan key-area reference and node-zone envelope are provisional design geometry.

role_route.role_action: Translate the reviewed component into resident-facing language and offline service instructions after a separate field review.
role_route.geometry_note: A receiving node and zone are intentionally unassigned until ownership, access and field conditions are witnessed.

role_route.role_action: Use the reviewed component only as a reversible, optional aid while ordinary wayfinding remains available.
role_route.geometry_note: A receiving node and zone are intentionally unassigned; no station or frontage deployment is claimed.

spatial_change.previous_condition: No component or test bay has been field established.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Keep a baseline route in the conceptual MAKE room with no AI sensing.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: A visible ordinary route is needed before any candidate output can be compared or stopped.

material_change.previous_condition: No material has been selected, procured or measured.
material_change.proposed_condition: Record a replaceable carrier and face as material placeholders only.
material_change.reason_for_change: The passport must begin a traceable physical lineage without inventing a procurement specification.

human_service_change.previous_condition: Ordinary static signs, paper information and human help are the baseline concept.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: Name a human steward and keep the baseline route available during design review.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: The first version must preserve service continuity and a non-AI comparison condition.

spatial_change.previous_condition: The baseline concept has no candidate content on the carrier.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Place a reversible candidate text face inside the closed MAKE test room.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: A contained spatial step lets reviewers inspect wording before any public-facing translation or use.

material_change.previous_condition: The carrier and face remain unselected placeholders.
material_change.proposed_condition: Separate the text face from its carrier with a tool-accessible reversible connection.
material_change.reason_for_change: Content should be replaceable without discarding the longer-life carrier or ground interface.

human_service_change.previous_condition: The human steward provides the only route explanation.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: A named human reviewer decides whether an AI candidate may be shown beside the baseline.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: AI text is an untrusted candidate; publication and route meaning remain human decisions.

spatial_change.previous_condition: The candidate face is confined to a visual-text review.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Add a detachable tactile and paper-map check in the same controlled room and yard.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: The spatial test must expose a step-free, low-tech bypass before any audio or sensing option is considered.

material_change.previous_condition: Only a replaceable visual face is represented in the concept bill of materials.
material_change.proposed_condition: Represent a separate tactile-map module and optional detachable audio module with unselected materials.
material_change.reason_for_change: Separate modules allow accessibility review, repair and removal without replacing the whole component.

human_service_change.previous_condition: Text review is led by a single content decision role.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: Add an independent accessibility reviewer and a human steward to the route rehearsal.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: Different access needs and failure modes require independent witnessing and a live human alternative.

spatial_change.previous_condition: The lineage is represented only in the closed MAKE room and yard.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Prepare the same serialized parts for a candidate indoor translation-room review; no receiving node is assigned.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: Resident-facing language should be tested in a human service setting without treating provisional geometry as a deployment location.

material_change.previous_condition: Tactile, visual and optional audio modules are separate concept parts.
material_change.proposed_condition: Keep all modules detachable and record their origin before a possible role transfer.
material_change.reason_for_change: A component passport must preserve repair and reuse options when the same object crosses from making to translation.

human_service_change.previous_condition: MAKE review is controlled by the prototype safety and accessibility roles.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: Add community language reviewers and retain a staffed counter, paper map and human referral.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: Translation is a public interpretation step, not an automated release; ordinary service cannot depend on a model.

spatial_change.previous_condition: The translated candidate remains an indoor review concept with no assigned public frontage.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Prepare a reversible USE demonstration beside ordinary wayfinding only after a separate access and safety decision.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: Daily use should test comprehension and bypass availability without making the component a gate to a station or service.

material_change.previous_condition: The serialized modules have no field-selected weather, structure or attachment specification.
material_change.proposed_condition: Keep the same parts removable and defer all material and connection selection to a witnessed detail review.
material_change.reason_for_change: No unverified material performance or permanent attachment should be implied by a concept passport.

human_service_change.previous_condition: Translation-room reviewers and a staffed counter are the human support path.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: Make a human steward, static signs, tactile map and paper route visible beside any optional aid.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: Public use must remain voluntary and ordinary wayfinding must continue if the prototype is refused or paused.

spatial_change.previous_condition: The USE demonstration is a reversible concept with no exit receipt.
spatial_change.proposed_condition: Return the same serialized parts to a candidate MAKE repair or reuse route after N0 restoration.
spatial_change.reason_for_change: The lineage ends only when public ground is restored and the next spatial destination is recorded, not when a screen is switched off.

material_change.previous_condition: All components remain unprocured and their condition is unknown.
material_change.proposed_condition: Separate parts into repair, reuse, material-recovery or quarantine streams with a custody receipt.
material_change.reason_for_change: A physical exit prevents waste and makes material responsibility auditable after a stop or review expiry.

human_service_change.previous_condition: The human steward and independent reviewer are defined as concept roles only.
human_service_change.proposed_condition: Give the repair lead a protected stop-work right and require independent review before any later restart.
human_service_change.reason_for_change: Workers and the public need an accountable pause, appeal and repair path before the component can re-enter any role.

allowed_inputs.description: Rights-cleared public place names and wayfinding phrases supplied for a candidate text review.
Synthetic multilingual accessibility prompts and route-conflict cases for a controlled red-team set.
A versioned model card describing limits, language coverage and prohibited uses.

allowed_outputs.description: Candidate multilingual plain-language labels and pronunciation alternatives for human comparison.
allowed_outputs.allowed_use: Show as an unapproved candidate beside the baseline sign during the closed 1:1 review only.

allowed_outputs.description: A red-team comparison sheet listing possible ambiguity, audio conflict and bypass questions.
allowed_outputs.allowed_use: Give the named reviewer a traceable review aid; never publish or route people automatically.

human_decisions.decision: Choose whether a candidate phrase is accurate, respectful and suitable for the intended route.
human_decisions.required_before: Any candidate is displayed to a test participant.

human_decisions.decision: Choose the placement, tactile treatment and human bypass for a witnessed route rehearsal.
human_decisions.required_before: Any component enters the N3 controlled test state.

human_decisions.decision: Accept, revise or reject a candidate after independent accessibility and red-team review.
human_decisions.required_before: Any proposed transition from MAKE to TRANSLATE or USE.

human_decisions.decision: Authorize a new test only after the stop reason, appeal and restoration records are closed.
human_decisions.required_before: Any restart after S2 or S3.

prohibited_actions: Approve construction, permits, ownership or engineering safety.
Publish candidate wording without human release and accessibility review.
Infer identity, biometrics, disability status or personal route histories.
Control traffic, emergency routing, station access or public-service eligibility.
Replace the static, tactile, paper or human wayfinding route.
Claim a field performance result, completed pilot or public endorsement.
Restart sensing or physical use after a stop without independent review.

components.component_role: detachable tactile and paper map module

materials.candidate_material_family: reusable sheet or panel substrate to be selected
materials.reuse_instruction: Inspect and return to the repair or reuse catalogue after exit.

materials.candidate_material_family: reversible mechanical fastener material to be selected
materials.reuse_instruction: Keep with the serialized frame unless a safety review requires quarantine.

materials.candidate_material_family: replaceable tactile surface material to be selected
materials.reuse_instruction: Inspect tactile legibility and route to reuse or material recovery.

materials.candidate_material_family: detachable electronics housing material if separately authorized
materials.reuse_instruction: Quarantine or transfer only after electrical and worker-safety review.

connections.connection_principle: Use a tool-accessible reversible mechanical connection; exact fastener is pending detail design.
Keep the tactile and text faces replaceable without discarding the carrier or altering ordinary ground.
Treat the optional audio or edge module as a detachable accessory with a separately isolated shutdown path.

disassembly_tools.tool_description: A non-proprietary hand tool matched to the selected reversible fastener, with a safe worker instruction.

expected_life.expiry_action: At the review-window end, set N0, restore ordinary service, inspect the kit and record repair, reuse, recovery or quarantine.

levels.definition: No sensing and no AI-dependent interface; the ordinary public route is the active condition.

retention.deletion_or_end_action: Do not create a sensing record.

no_sensing_mask.mask_rule: No sensing anywhere in the zone during ordinary service.

levels.definition: Only non-identifying aggregate observation may be considered after a separate public review.

retention.deletion_or_end_action: Keep the zone at N0 until a separate protocol is witnessed.

no_sensing_mask.mask_rule: Keep all non-authorized sensing masked across the entire zone.

levels.definition: Only voluntary, visibly announced interaction may be considered with an immediate human bypass.

retention.deletion_or_end_action: Keep the zone at N0 until consent, privacy and service tests are witnessed.

no_sensing_mask.mask_rule: Mask the entire zone until voluntary interaction and bypass tests are independently reviewed.

levels.definition: A closed controlled test may log only non-personal events with a named operator, mask and independent reviewer.

retention.deletion_or_end_action: Delete the event log at the concept limit unless a witnessed retention rule says otherwise.

no_sensing_mask.mask_rule: Use a public-boundary no-capture mask and forbid outward sensing from the closed test room.

equivalents.ordinary_service_function: Provide the baseline multilingual route without a model or sensor.
equivalents.availability_condition: Keep visible whenever the prototype is paused or removed.

equivalents.ordinary_service_function: Provide a tactile route explanation that does not require a digital interface.
equivalents.availability_condition: Provide after accessibility review and keep a paper alternative during review.

equivalents.ordinary_service_function: Provide a take-away or desk-held route map for offline wayfinding.
equivalents.availability_condition: Keep stocked by a human counter before any N3 entry is considered.

equivalents.ordinary_service_function: Provide human route explanation, accompaniment and complaint intake.
equivalents.availability_condition: Name and train the steward before a field witness; do not substitute an AI response.

physical_state_receipts.public_condition: No prototype kit is in the public setting; ordinary wayfinding and the accessible bypass remain the only active service.
entry_conditions: Official geometry and baseline route are still unverified.
No deployment approval, field witness or procurement record exists.
required_actions: Keep all sensing and optional interfaces off.
Prepare a baseline condition record before any later entry.

physical_state_receipts.public_condition: A witnessed one-to-one test may be visible inside the closed room while the ordinary route remains usable beside it.
entry_conditions: A human owner, independent reviewer and accessible bypass have been witnessed.
The entry checklist, model card and material record are complete.
required_actions: Log only the authorized non-personal test event.
Keep a human steward able to take over immediately.

physical_state_receipts.public_condition: The sensing and prototype output are stopped; the ordinary route and human/offline service continue without an AI gate.
entry_conditions: A stop trigger, pause request or worker stop-work notice has been recorded.
The zone has visibly returned to N0 and the kit is isolated from use.
required_actions: Publish the stop reason through a human and paper channel.
Open independent review and protect the accessible bypass.

physical_state_receipts.public_condition: The baseline ground and ordinary route are restored, and every component has a recorded repair, reuse, recovery or quarantine destination.
entry_conditions: The stop review does not authorize continued use, or the review window has ended.
A ground condition check and component custody decision are ready for witnessing.
required_actions: Remove the kit without blocking or degrading the accessible route.
Issue a custody receipt before any component leaves the site.

immediate_stop_sequence: Set the AI service zone to N0 before debating the cause.
Stop sensing, audio and generated output at the physical interface.
Keep static, tactile, paper and human wayfinding available.
Record the reason through a human-readable fault and pause log.
Isolate the kit and protect workers, users and the accessible bypass.

appeal_and_complaint.non_digital_route: Accept a paper, phone or in-person appeal without requiring an AI account.

frontline_worker_stop_work.safe_alternative_work: Keep the ordinary service route open and move the task to a safe inspection or repair review.

restart_gate: Independent reviewer records a reasoned decision.
The public complaint or appeal path is open and understandable.
The ordinary human and offline route has been checked.
The component, mask and ground condition are rechecked.
A human owner authorizes any later state transition.

ground_restoration.restoration_rule: Return the documented pre-entry ground condition and keep the accessible route at least as usable as the witnessed baseline.
ground_restoration.accessible_route_protection: Do not leave a mount, cable, sign face or queue that blocks the ordinary accessible bypass.

component_transfer.transfer_rule: Move a serialized component only with a condition, origin and receiving-role receipt; quarantine unsafe or untraceable parts.

material_transfer.unsafe_material_rule: Do not reuse a material until its condition, origin and worker-safety route are independently checked.

official_geometry.effect: The SITE, key-area and service-zone geometry is provisional and cannot support a redline or measured field of view.
official_geometry.required_before: Any field placement or spatial performance claim.

title_or_ownership.effect: No right to occupy, attach, operate or remove a component has been established.
title_or_ownership.required_before: Any physical installation or custody handoff.

operating_capacity.effect: Staffing, queue, accessibility, maintenance and ordinary-service capacity have not been baselined.
operating_capacity.required_before: Any schedule, staffing or service-continuity claim.

funding.effect: No budget, procurement source or compensation arrangement is secured by this concept passport.
funding.required_before: Any purchase, paid test or implementation statement.

permits.effect: No planning, rail, heritage, fire, flood, electrical, privacy or event permit is represented.
permits.required_before: Any installation, sensing, public event or change to ordinary ground.

field_witness.effect: No physical state, route, material, exposure mask or receipt has been witnessed on site.
field_witness.required_before: Any claim that a version, state or service has occurred.

claim_boundary.interpretation_note: This file is a machine-readable design contract and synthetic concept example. It describes what a future professional team must record before and after a reversible test; it does not report a built object, a measured dimension, a performance result or an official decision.
